title: Abahemuki b'Abatoranijwe .
intro: Mu mateka yose, intumwa z’Imana zagendagenda mu bantu, kandi bamwe mu bari hafi cane ntibamenye umuco. Iyi nkuru izunguruka ubugingo bubiri, ukuntu bari hafi y’ubuhanuzi vyacitse ikigeragezo cabo, kandi iragi ryabo rikaba icigwa kitagira iherezo.
clues: Twarabaye mu bihe vy’abahanuzi bakuru, yamara amaso yacu yagumye yugaye ku kuri bazana.
Amazu yacu yari yuzuye ihishurirwa ry’Imana, ariko imitima yacu yari ikomeye.
Twari twarongowe n’abagabo batowe ngo baburire abantu babo.
Igihe igihano caza, ntitwarondera ubuhungiro mu bwato canke ngo duhunge imvura y’umuriro, kuko twatwenga imburi.
Turavugwa muri Korowani nk’akarorero ku batemera, vyerekana ko n’ubucuti bwa hafi n’umuhanuzi butakiza.
Turi abagore ba Nuh na Luti, abahemukiye, gutyo bagacirirwa urubanza.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
